component.name: Tiana Tables
component.summary: Browse and query MySQL and MariaDB databases

description.p: Tiana Tables is a desktop client for MySQL and MariaDB, aimed at developers who read and edit data as much as they write queries.

ul.li: Browse tables, filter rows and follow foreign keys between them
Edit cells in place, with the primary key guarding the update
Write SQL in an editor with completion and validation from a real grammar
Chart a query result without leaving the app
Keep several connections, each remembering the database and table you left
Light and dark base16 themes, in English and French

description.p: Connection passwords are encrypted with the system keyring.
